channel.description: Latest articles from The Garden Island (thegardenisland.com)

item.title: Police seek public’s help to locate missing man
item.description: LIHUE — The Kauai Police Department (KPD) is requesting the public’s assistance in locating a man who was reported missing.

item.title: Math at center of Hawaii’s education priorities for 2026 session
item.description: Math readiness has emerged as a defining education issue for Hawaii as lawmakers and school leaders prepare for the 2026 legislative cycle, framing numeracy not only as an academic concern but as a foundation for workforce readiness, economic mobility and long-term student success.

item.title: Distressed hikers rescued on Kalalau Trail Thursday
item.description: LIHUE — Personnel from the Kauai Fire Department rescued a 51-year-old male German visitor from the Kalalau Trail on Thursday, along with one minor hiking with him.

item.title: Staying visible: A peaceful rally honoring victims of Minnesota shootings
item.description: Kauai Indivisible hosted a peaceful “visibility” rally that attracted about 200 people on Thursday to the sidewalks fronting Kaumualii Highway near the Kauai Community College.

item.title: ‘Sharktober’ is real: UH study confirms shark bites do increase in October
item.description: Do more tiger shark bites occur in Hawaii during the month of October?

item.title: Newborn Big Island monk seal doing well in hospital
item.description: A newborn Hawaiian monk seal plucked from the shores of Hawaii island last month is now gaining weight at Ke Kai Ola, a monk seal hospital in Kailua-Kona.

item.title: Road closures for the week of January 31 – February 6
item.description: LIHUE — A number of road-related projects are on tap in the days ahead with grass cutting, tree trimming and guardrail repair making up the bulk of the work, the Hawaii Department of Transportation said in an update on Friday.

item.title: Palau’s president says U.S. leaders need to ‘show up’ in Pacific
item.description: The island nation of Palau, home to just under 18,000 people living on 500 small islands, has become an out sized player on the global stage as the U.S. and China compete for influence across the Pacific islands.

item.title: U.S. Senate budget bill includes $75 million for Hawaii
item.description: The bipartisan funding package approved by the U.S. Senate today includes nearly $75 in earmarks for Hawaii, according to U.S. Sen. Brian Schatz.

item.title: Multiagency search suspended following discovery of human remains
item.description: KILAUEA – The three-day multiagency search for a missing Kauai man has been suspended following the discovery of human remains in waters off Kahili Beach on Saturday afternoon.
